items.back: What colour is the girl's sweater?

items.cand: (The dog is) small / white.
items.back: Is the dog small / white?

p2.title: Let's play a game
p2.intro: It's a rainy day. Daisy and Fred can't go out to play. They aren't happy. Their mother is saying, 'Let's play a game.'

pics.say: Daisy and Fred start playing a game with their mum.
pics.back: What are the children doing? Who is with them?

pics.say: Daisy and Fred are enjoying the game. Their mum isn't enjoying it.
pics.back: Are the children happy? Is their mum enjoying the game?

pics.say: Their mum isn't happy. Now the children are saying, 'Let's play a game.'
pics.back: Is their mum happy? What are the children saying?

p3.intro: Here are four pictures. Which one is different? This one is different (point to the book). A lemon, a pineapple and an orange are fruit. You eat them. You don't eat a book. You read it. Now, you tell me about these pictures. Which one is different?

sets.say: A lemon, a pineapple and an orange are fruit. You eat them. You don't eat a book. You read it.

names: playing a game = chơi trò chơi
reading on a sofa = đọc sách trên ghế sofa
sets.say: In this picture the children are outside but in the others they are inside.
sets.back: Where are the children here?

sets.say: This picture is a girl but the others are animals.
sets.back: Are these animals? Is this a girl?

sets.say: This picture is a drink but the others are food.
sets.back: Can you eat this? Can you drink it?

p4.intro: Now, (name), let's talk about your friends.

qs.q: How many friends have you got?
qs.back: Have you got two friends?

qs.q: What's your best friend's name?
qs.back: Is your best friend's name Mary?

qs.q: Is he / she tall or short?
qs.back: Is (Mary) tall?

qs.q: Tell me about your best friend's hobbies.
qs.back: Does he / she like playing sports? Does he / she play games?

p2c.s: Daisy = Daisy; Fred = Fred; Mum = mẹ
p2c.l: in the living room = trong phòng khách; on the sofa = trên ghế sofa

p2c.l: in the living room = trong phòng khách; on the sofa = trên ghế sofa

They play a game with Mum in the kitchen.
The children like the game. Mum doesn't like it.

p2.title: The birthday cake
p2.intro: The family are in the kitchen. Jane and Mary are having breakfast with their mum and dad. It's their dad's birthday today and they want to give him a surprise.

pics.say: The girls (Jane and Mary) are making a birthday cake for their dad. Their mum is watching. She isn't happy.
pics.back: What are the girls doing? Is their mum happy?

pics.say: They are having a birthday party for their dad. There is food and drink on the table.
pics.back: Where are the people? What are they doing? Are they enjoying it?

pics.say: The girls are bringing their dad's birthday cake. Their father is very surprised.
pics.back: What are the girls doing? Is their father surprised?

p3.intro: Show students the first set of pictures and say: Here are four pictures. Which one is different? This one is different (point to the dog). A lime, an apple and an orange are fruit. You eat them. A dog is not a fruit. It's an animal. Now look at these pictures (show next set). Which one is different? (Why?)

sets.say: A lime, an apple and an orange are fruit. You eat them. A dog is not a fruit. It's an animal.

names: playing football in the park = chơi bóng đá ở công viên
playing football near a house = chơi bóng đá gần nhà

playing football on the beach = chơi bóng đá trên bãi biển
sets.say: In this picture they are reading but in the others they are playing football.
sets.back: What are the children doing here?

sets.say: The hat is clothes but the others are things you drink out of.
sets.back: What is this? Is it a drink?

sets.say: This is a boy but the others are animals.
sets.back: Is this an animal? Is this a boy?

p4.intro: Now, (name), let's talk about your home.

qs.q: How many people live in your house?
qs.back: Have you got two sisters?

qs.q: Where do you eat breakfast?
qs.back: Do you eat breakfast in the kitchen?

qs.q: Which room do you like best?
Tell me about your bedroom.
qs.a: It's white. It's small. It's got toys.
qs.back: Do you like your bedroom? Is it big or small? What colour are the walls?

p2c.s: Jane and Mary = Jane và Mary; Mum and Dad = mẹ và bố
p2c.l: in the kitchen = trong bếp; at the table = ở bàn
p2c.v: have breakfast = ăn sáng; talk = nói chuyện

p2c.l: in the kitchen = trong bếp
p2c.v: make a cake = làm bánh; watch = xem

p2c.v: have a party = tổ chức tiệc; eat and drink = ăn và uống

p2c.s: the girls = hai bạn gái; Dad = bố
p2c.l: in the kitchen = trong bếp
p2c.v: bring the cake = mang bánh đến; look at the cake = nhìn bánh

story: The family have breakfast. It is Dad's birthday today.
Jane and Mary make a birthday cake. Mum watches. She is not happy.
They have a birthday party for Dad. There is food and drink on the table.
The girls bring the cake. Dad is very surprised.

hints.p1: picture = bức tranh; wall = bức tường; clock = đồng hồ; glasses = kính; straight hair = tóc thẳng; curly hair = tóc xoăn; book = quyển sách; shoes = giày; blue = xanh dương; white = trắng
hints.p2: kitchen = nhà bếp; breakfast = bữa sáng; birthday = sinh nhật; make a cake = làm bánh; surprise = bất ngờ; party = bữa tiệc; food = đồ ăn; drink = đồ uống

hints.p4: house = ngôi nhà; kitchen = nhà bếp; bedroom = phòng ngủ; room = căn phòng; toys = đồ chơi; small = nhỏ; big = to

p2.title: Charlie loses his ball
p2.intro: Charlie is in the park with his dog. He's kicking a ball.

pics.say: Charlie kicks the ball and it goes into the lake. He can't get it.
pics.back: What did Charlie do? Where is the ball? Can Charlie get his ball?

pics.say: The dog is swimming in the lake. He is getting the ball.
pics.back: What's the dog doing?

pics.say: The dog has got the ball. Charlie is happy. He is giving his dog a biscuit.
pics.back: Where is Charlie's ball now? Is Charlie happy?

p3.intro: Show students the first set of pictures and say: Here are four pictures. Which one is different? This one is different (point to the panda). A dolphin, a shark and a whale all live in the sea. A panda lives on land. Now look at these pictures (show next set). Which one is different? (Why?)

sets.say: A dolphin, a shark and a whale all live in the sea. A panda lives on land.

names: sitting on a chair and reading = ngồi đọc sách trên ghế
sets.say: In this picture she is reading / sitting down but in the others she is doing sport / standing up.
sets.back: What is the girl doing in these pictures? In this picture?

names: hat on the chair = mũ ở trên ghế
sets.say: In this picture the hat is on the chair but in the others the things are under the chair.
sets.back: Where are the things in these pictures?

girl cooking = bạn nữ đang nấu ăn
man cooking = chú đang nấu ăn
girl making a cake = bạn nữ làm bánh
sets.say: In this picture the boy is eating but in the others the people are cooking.
sets.back: What are the people doing? What is the boy doing?

p4.intro: Now, (name), let's talk about your room.

qs.q: Is your room big or small?
qs.back: Is your room big?

qs.q: Have you got a TV in your room?
Where do you do your homework?
qs.back: Do you do your homework at the desk?

qs.q: Tell me what is in your room.
qs.a: There is a bed, a chair and a desk.
qs.back: Have you got a mirror? Are there pictures on the wall?

items.ex: the horse is brown.
items.cand: (The horse is) white and black.
items.back: Is the horse brown?

items.ex: there are four rabbits.
items.cand: There are three rabbits.
items.back: How many rabbits are there?

items.ex: it's raining.
items.cand: It isn't raining. / It's cloudy.
items.back: Is it raining?

items.ex: the man has got a beard.
items.cand: The man has got a moustache.
items.back: Has he got a beard?

p2.title: Where's Spot?
p2.intro: It's a nice, sunny day. Mary goes out to draw a picture. She is with her dog, Spot.

pics.say: Mary is drawing a picture of her dog. Spot sees a cat and starts running.
pics.back: What is Mary doing? What can Spot see?

pics.say: Mary is looking for Spot but she can't see him.
pics.back: Who is Mary looking for? Can she see Spot?

pics.say: Mary finds Spot. He is sitting next to the cat. They look happy.
pics.back: Where is Spot? Is he happy?

p3.intro: Show students the first set of pictures and say: Here are four pictures. Which one is different? This one is different (point to the third boy). He is happy. The other boys have got a headache, an earache and a stomach-ache. Now look at these pictures (show next set). Which one is different? (Why?)

names: happy boy = bạn nam vui vẻ
sets.say: He is happy. The other boys have got a headache, an earache and a stomach-ache.
A kangaroo is an animal but the others are different jobs (a doctor, a nurse, a policewoman).
sets.back: What are their jobs? What is this?

sets.say: You find this in a bedroom but you find the others in a bathroom.
sets.back: Where can you find these? Where can you find a bed?

names: girl eating = bạn nữ đang ăn
boy eating = bạn nam đang ăn
girl eating pizza = bạn nữ ăn pizza
boy watching TV = bạn nam xem TV
sets.say: This boy is watching TV but the others are eating.
sets.back: What are the people doing? What is the boy doing?

p4.intro: Now, (name), let's talk about your weekends.

qs.q: What do you like to do on Sunday?
qs.back: Do you play games?

qs.q: Who do you play with at the weekend?
qs.back: Do you play with your friends?

qs.q: When do you do your homework?
qs.back: Do you do your homework in the morning?

qs.q: Tell me about things you like to do at weekends.
qs.a: I play football. I go shopping.
qs.back: Do you go shopping? When do you go shopping? Do you play sports? What sports do you play?

p2c.s: Mary = Mary; Spot = Spot (con chó)
p2c.l: in the park = trong công viên; on a sunny day = trong ngày nắng
p2c.v: go out = đi ra ngoài; draw a picture = vẽ tranh

p2c.s: Mary = Mary; Spot = Spot; the cat = con mèo
p2c.l: in the park = trong công viên
p2c.v: draw a picture = vẽ tranh; see a cat = thấy con mèo; run = chạy

p2c.s: Mary = Mary
p2c.l: in the park = trong công viên; near the trees = gần cái cây
p2c.v: look for Spot = tìm Spot; can't see = không thấy

p2c.s: Mary = Mary; Spot = Spot; the cat = con mèo
p2c.l: next to the cat = cạnh con mèo
p2c.v: find Spot = tìm thấy Spot; sit = ngồi

Mary draws a picture of Spot. Spot sees a cat and runs.
Mary looks for Spot. She can't see him. She is worried.
Mary finds Spot. He is sitting next to the cat. They look happy.

p2.title: Clever Fred
p2.intro: It's a sunny day. The two boys are playing football next to the lake. They have a picnic too. The dog is watching the ducks in the lake.

pics.back: Where is the ball now? Are the boys happy?

pics.back: What is the dog doing? What are the boys doing?

pics.back: Point to the boy. What's that boy doing? Point to the other boy. What's that boy doing? Are they happy?

p3.intro: Now look at these four pictures. One is different. This one is different. In these pictures, the woman is playing sports – football, tennis and basketball. But she's not playing a sport in this picture. She's sitting on a sofa and she's watching TV. Now you tell me about these pictures. Which one is different? Why?

sets.say: In these pictures, the woman is playing sports – football, tennis and basketball. But she's not playing a sport in this picture. She's sitting on a sofa and she's watching TV.
The kangaroo is different. The kangaroo is an animal. The skirt, the sweater and the scarf are clothes.
sets.back: What things can you wear? Point to the kangaroo. Can you wear that?

sets.say: The horse is different. The horse doesn't live in the sea. The dolphin, the shark and the whale live in the sea.
sets.back: Where do these animals live? Which animals live in the sea? Which animal doesn't live in the sea?

sets.say: The hospital is different. You can travel in a train, a car and a bus. You can't travel in a hospital.

qs.back: Do you play games with your friends?

qs.q: Tell me about your teacher.
qs.a: My teacher is called Mrs Tell. She's nice. She's young and she doesn't shout very often.
qs.back: Is your teacher a man or woman? What's his / her name? Is he / she young or old? Is he / she nice? Does he / she often shout?

p2.title: Kite comes home
p2.intro: The girl and the man are at the park. She is holding a blue kite. It's a very windy day. She's happy.

p3.intro: Now look at these four pictures. One is different. The sweater is different because it's a thing you wear. These three pictures are all places in a town. Now you tell me about these pictures. Which one is different? Why?
